text:
maya: Quick design review of the preflight summary card on the Private setup wizard. The current card stacks a lot: probe totals, last-run time, retry CTA, and a big status badge. It's hard to scan on small screens.

zack: agreed. on narrow layouts the badge pushes the title down. suggest moving the status badge to the left as a 16px indicator and keep the badge text inline with the title.

lina: good call. also the retry CTA is currently a full-width button under the card. can we make it an inline link-style action to reduce visual weight? maybe a simple "Retry probes" text button with an icon.

maya: I like inline actions. but we should keep the primary action for failed probes prominent (e.g., "Run network repair"). so inline for retry, primary for repair when needed.

sam: accessibility note: we need to ensure the summary card follows a logical tab order. Right now the keyboard focus jumps from title to badge then to nested probe rows; tabindex feels off. Keyboard users should be able to expand/collapse details with Enter/Space.

lina: propose making the collapse control the first interactive element after the heading, with an aria-expanded state and a clear keyboard focus ring. Example markup: 
```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="probe-details">Show probe details</button>
```
This avoids focusless divs.

sam: also add aria-describedby linking to an offscreen summary: "3 of 7 probes passed" so screen readers get a concise result before expanding.

zack: copy nit: current header says "Connectivity status". that's vague. suggestion: "Network preflight — 3/7 probes passed". short and actionable.

maya: +1. for failed probes we show "Learn more" which feels passive. change to "See fix suggestions" or "View fixes" to imply next steps.

lina: UX for mobile: collapsed details should show the first failing probe inline, with a chevron to expand others. helps with quick triage.

sam: voiceover testing note: avoid live region updates while focus is inside the card or it will move focus unexpectedly. Use aria-live="polite" on a summary slot and only announce stable state changes (debounced).

zack: after the build I'm noticing the amber warning color doesn't meet 4.5:1 on the light surface. will attach hexes in the ticket.

maya: action items: (1) zack to move badge left + mobile layout tweak; (2) lina to implement aria-expanded + sr-describedby; (3) sam to run keyboard/VO pass; (4) maya to update microcopy and swap CTAs. Review in design sync Friday 11am.

lina: filed TICKET-4230 with screenshots and a small gif of the expanded behaviour. I'll add a note about avoiding too many live updates when users are interacting.

maya: thanks all — this should make preflight a lot easier to scan for customers onboarding Private deployments. :sparkles:
